{{Quote|The devil you say, young Farsten. I have no intention of selling you the ''ou'tranoi'' for 100 credits, or indeed for any other sum. Although its powers are poorly understood, I have every faith it will prove to be vital to the completion of our mission.|Jackson Farseeker|<ref name="TRG1-36" />}}
The '''ou'tranoi''' was a mysterious [[Alien/Legends|alien]] device in the possession of retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jackson Farseeker]]. At some point, Farseeker's companion, [[Farsten]], attempted to acquire the device by using his bargaining skills to buy it for the sum of a hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Farseeker, however, refused to part with the device for any sum.<ref name="TRG1-36" />
